entries.tutorialSubtitle: Pinched Piedmontese pasta filled with braised meat, in roasting juices
entries.tutorialExcerpt: Agnolotti al plin are tiny Piedmontese stuffed pasta parcels, the size of a grape, filled with braised meat and Parmesan and served simply with the reduced juices from the braising pan. Plin means pinch in Piedmontese -- the pasta is formed by pinching small pockets along a folded strip of dough. They are a dish of economy and skill, made traditionally from Sunday's leftover braised meats.
